summary.text: Debbie Dolgin is a Republican state representative from the Caledonia-Essex District who has served in the Vermont House of Representatives since January 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Debbie Dolgin, listed by Ballotpedia as Deborah Cordz Dolgin, was born in New Jersey.
Dolgin earned a bachelor's degree from the State University of New York, Plattsburgh, and a master's degree from the University of Vermont.
Dolgin's career experience includes working as a small business owner and educator.
Dolgin was elected to the Caledonia-Essex District seat in November 2024, and in 2026 won the Republican primary alongside Steven Dolgin.
